title: Implementation timeline & risk register — NovaPay (Dedicated)
content:
Purpose:
This working tracker is intended for the CS + Solutions handoff and weekly QBR preparation for the NovaPay dedicated inference rollout. Focus is on absolute milestone status, single-point owners, current blockers and mitigation, and a compact risk register that feeds the renewal conversation (T-90 / T-30 / T-0 checkpoints).

High-level summary:
- Customer: NovaPay (payments fintech)
- Deployment mode: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool, private tenant)
- Primary success metric: 99th percentile latency <= 250ms for typical payment payload, availability 99.95% SLA after cutover
- Business impact: Real-time fraud scoring integration for checkout flow (impact to transaction throughput and revenue)

Milestone timeline (living):
1) Discovery & SOW sign-off — owner: Maya Patel — target: 2025-09-19 — status: complete
2) Capacity reservation & billing setup — owner: FinanceOps (Liam O'Connor) — target: 2025-10-03 — status: complete
3) Network design & VPC peering (security review) — owner: Sofia Martinez — target: 2025-10-17 — status: complete
4) Model onboarding & quantization validation — owner: Ethan Zhang — target: 2025-11-07 — status: complete
5) Integration sandbox (end-to-end smoke) — owner: NovaPay Eng (primary: Karen Liu) — target: 2025-11-21 — status: complete
6) Performance tuning (batching/kv-cache) — owner: Serving Runtime (Roberto Diaz) — target: 2025-12-05 — status: in_progress (70%)
7) Security + compliance review (SOC audit prep) — owner: Security (Priya Rao) — target: 2025-12-12 — status: in_progress (document collection)
8) Canary (limited traffic) — owner: Solutions Eng (Sofia Martinez) — target: 2026-01-09 — status: blocked (see blockers)
9) Full cutover / go-live — owner: Customer Success (Maya Patel) — target: 2026-01-23 — status: pending
10) Post-cutover stabilization (30d) — owner: SRE (Oncall rotation) — target: 2026-02-22 — status: pending

Milestone owners & contacts:
- Maya Patel (CS lead) — maya.patel@redwood.ai — slack: @maya
- Liam O'Connor (FinanceOps) — liam.o@redwood.ai — slack: @liam
- Sofia Martinez (Solutions Eng) — sofia.m@redwood.ai — slack: @sofia
- Ethan Zhang (Applied ML) — ethan.z@redwood.ai — slack: @ethan
- Priya Rao (Security) — priya.r@redwood.ai — slack: @priya
- Karen Liu (NovaPay Eng lead) — karen.l@nvp.com — slack: @karen

Current blockers (active):
A) Canary traffic gating (primary blocker) — severity: high — reported: 2025-12-28
   - Symptom: NovaPay internal policy requires PCI-internal staging for live-card identifiers; their compliance team will not allow traffic to align with our canary hosts until tokenization flow is validated in a mirrored env.
   - Impact: Prevents canary launch; delays full cutover timeline by unknown delta
   - Owner: Sofia Martinez (Solutions) / Karen Liu (NovaPay)
   - Mitigation options:
     1) Create a fenced tokenization mirror in customer sandbox (short-term) — ETA: 2 weeks if resources approved by NovaPay
     2) Use synthetic tokenized payloads + replay to validate latency/throughput (lower assurance) — ETA: 3 days
   - Recommended next step: prioritize option (1) if NovaPay approves resource allocation; escalate to CSM exec sponsor if approval stalls past 72h.

B) Audit artifact gap — severity: medium — reported: 2025-12-10
   - Symptom: Missing data retention policy evidence for SOC readiness (NovaPay needs attestation of log retention and KMS rotation notes).
   - Owner: Priya Rao (Security)
   - Mitigation: Draft attestation memo and schedule joint evidence collection session (target 5 business days).

C) Model variance at long tail — severity: medium — reported: 2025-11-30
   - Symptom: Quantized model shows 0.8% regression on rare fraud patterns vs baseline; product team needs to sign off on acceptable accuracy delta.
   - Owner: Ethan Zhang (Applied ML) + NovaPay ML team
   - Mitigation: Run focused evaluation set + fallback policy to higher-precision variant for flagged requests; deploy canary to 5% traffic to measure real-world impact.

Risk register (top 6):
- R1 (High): Customer gating on compliance artifacts -> Can block Canary/Go-live. Mitigation: daily audit standups, exec sponsor involvement, documented escalation.
- R2 (High): Unexpected production latency at 95th/99th percentile after mixed traffic -> Mitigation: autoscaling buffer, emergency fallback to regional hosted model, pre-warmed pools.
- R3 (Medium): Cost overshoot if batch sizes not optimized with real traffic -> Mitigation: Optimize batching config during canary, implement token-level cost alerts in Console.
- R4 (Medium): Regression in model accuracy post-quantization -> Mitigation: fallback variant + supervised evaluation and threshold gating.
- R5 (Low): Deployment/config drift between staging and dedicated tenant -> Mitigation: infra-as-code diff and pre-cutover checklist execution.
- R6 (Low): Renewal pressure if go-live slips beyond T-30 -> Mitigation: customer success QBR focused on business impact metrics; propose temporary pricing accommodations if needed.

Action items (next 7 days):
- [Sofia] Coordinate NovaPay approval for tokenization mirror; get PO / resource sign-off by EOD +3 (owner track: CS-1723).
- [Priya] Complete audit attestation memo and assign evidence owners; schedule evidence collection call for 2026-01-05.
- [Ethan] Run 50k-sample focused eval for rare fraud cases; deliver comparison report by 2026-01-04.
- [Roberto] Tune KV cache warm-up and batching thresholds; target 10% latency improvement on 99th percentile by 2026-01-06.
- [Maya] Prep T-30 renewal talking points linking latency SLA to projected revenue uplift; draft slide for 2026-01-10 QBR.

Escalation path (if blockers unresolved >72h):
1) CSM -> Solutions Eng lead (Sofia) -> Security lead (Priya)
2) If still unresolved -> CS Director (Ruth Kim) + Head of Solutions (Anil Mehra) -> Exec sponsor (Douglas Park)
Contact matrix and SLAs: any blocker tagged high must receive a response ack within 4 hours on weekdays; ownership updates daily until mitigated.

Meeting cadence and artifacts:
- Weekly rollout sync (Tues 10:00 PST) — standing invite, agenda: status, blockers, risks, next actions (owners update).
- Pre-canary readiness call (when blocked items <=1) — ad-hoc.
- Post-cutover 30-day stability review (template in linked Confluence).
- Artifacts to maintain in this doc: milestone delta log (append below), decision register (append decisions + timestamp), and a short QBR slide deck pulled from this tracker.

Handoff checklist for cutover (compact):
- [ ] Billing / commitment verified and charged
- [ ] Network peering active and tested (latency metrics < 2ms RTT internal)
- [ ] Secrets and KMS rotations verified in dedicated tenant
- [ ] Canary traffic plan and rollback path documented
- [ ] Oncall rotation and runbooks published and shared with NovaPay
- [ ] Acceptance criteria for go-live (latency, accuracy, error rate) signed by NovaPay

Notes / open questions (for CS & Solutions):
- Q1: If NovaPay cannot allocate sandbox infra for mirror, is customer willing to accept extended canary (longer duration) in lieu of mirror?
- Q2: Are there contract language levers for partial fee abatement if go-live slips beyond the agreed milestone? Finance Ops to confirm.

Appendix (milestone delta log — recent changes):
- 2026-01-03: Canary delayed due to tokenization mirror approval (added blocker A).
- 2025-12-22: Performance tuning effort increased scope to include KV cache pre-warm (Roberto assigned).
- 2025-12-11: Audit artifact gap discovered during SOC prep call (Priya assigned).

Owner notes (for the record):
- This document is intended to be the single source-of-truth for weekly status and for extracting the 3–5 slides we use in renewal conversations. Keep changes minimal and append-only for the milestone delta log.
- If you edit the milestone dates, add an entry to the delta log with rationale and owner.
